response.answer: Put the postmortem track first. You’ve said your confidence should follow confirmed evidence, and you experienced the cost of naming a cause before the repro was complete. The postmortem role’s deliberate written timeline fits that standard better than incident-comms’ first-voice, fastest-statement mandate; its VP visibility is also not clearly tied to meaningful work. This recommendation is based on those stated preferences and experiences, not on any broader career information.
